announcements.headline: Demerger of Senegal Assets
announcements.insight: Demergers in junior mining are typically executed to unlock trapped value by allowing distinct asset profiles (e.g., near-term production vs. long-term exploration) to attract specialized capital and valuation multiples. This structural separation often serves as a precursor to monetization or strategic partnership for the Senegal project, addressing liquidity constraints common in small-cap explorers.
